faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APS Kamptee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for APS Kamptee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (http://www.apskamptee.in) and send it to Army Public School Kamptee, Pin Code 441001, by registered post and email, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for APS Kamptee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is min 40 years and Max 50 years. Max age limit for Regular APS employees and ESM will be 55 years (as on 1 April 2026). Relaxation: Regular APS employees and ESM 55.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Negotiable.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters Degree with 50% marks, B.Ed with 50% marks, and 8 years experience as PGT or 15 years combined PGT/TGT experience.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Adequate working knowledge of computers/MS Office/MS PowerPoint required.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualification and experience. Panel interview. Panel interviews for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kamptee.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Resume; Photograph; Experience certificates; Educational certificates/testimonials.
